summary: Playbook to fetch the monthly metrics-utility report on OpenShift (needs kubernetes.core): create a temporary busybox pod mounting the automationcontroller-metrics-utility PVC at /mnt/metrics with kubernetes.core.k8s, and wait with k8s_info until its container is ready.
questions: How do I get the metrics-utility report from OpenShift?
Which PVC holds the metrics-utility reports?
How do I read files from a PVC with Ansible?
